title: A great addition to any kitchen, I couldn't think of an easier, tastier way to cook for my family
text: A great addition to any kitchen, I couldn't think of an easier, tastier way to cook for my family. These are my absolute favorite items to keep in my kitchen pantry. I use my slow cooker at least 2-3 times a month and these liners make cleanup an absolute breeze. There is no easier way to cook on the planet besides using the cooker and the liners together. I was originally a little leery about using them, wondering if there would be any impact on the taste of the foods. But Reynolds truly knows how to make quality products that make our lives simpler and easier. If you are going to a bridal shower or a first time apt/homeowner, these would make a great gift (of course with a slow cooker).

description: Make memorable meals with Reynolds Kitchens Slow Cooker Liners, and save time on cleanup. Grab these slow cooker bags for slow cooking without dealing with stubborn, stuck-on messes. Simply lift the slow cooker liner when the cooking is done and your slow cooker is clean in less than eight seconds—guaranteed! Each slow cooker bag measures 13 x 21 inches to fit 1- to 3-quart round and oval slow cookers, and is made with a BPA-free heat resistant (up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit) nylon-blend construction. Spend more time with your loved ones and less time in the kitchen with these FDA-compliant, food-safe Reynolds Kitchens Slow Cooker Liners.
